bundled_libreoffice.diagnosis: handleGroupChr reads chr and pos but ignores vertJc; non-brace characters are reduced to csup/csub on the label. Outer limLow then appends another csub, creating duplicate centered subscripts for dual labels.

limitations: Microsoft Word OMML-to-MathML XSL checks structure and label/direction preservation, not native Word layout.
Word XSL does not preserve every OMML property in its MathML output, including explicit argument size.
Browser MathML is a separate rendering engine.
Dual-label groupChr width need not cover a longer lower label; exact KaTeX spacing and minimum arrow width are not claimed.
